title: Bounded lock for Multi-Site health alert acknowledgement
opportunity: Health alert acknowledgement wrote PostgreSQL state without the Site mutation lock used by add/update/delete, so concurrent Site changes could race and a lock wait was not bounded.
rootCause: The acknowledgement endpoint called AcknowledgeHealthAlertAsync directly after reading the trend; no advisory-lock lease or site_mutation_busy boundary covered the write.
implementation: Acquired the existing bounded Site mutation lock before the acknowledgement write.
Returned the existing 503 site_mutation_busy ProblemDetails when the lock budget expires.
Disposed the advisory-lock lease in a finally block on success, database failure, cancellation and timeout.

tdd.red: SiteHealthAlertMutationLockTests initially failed because the acknowledgement endpoint did not acquire the mutation lock; the existing mutation count contract then caught and was updated for the fourth guarded endpoint.

verification.uiAuditBoundary: backend-only change; no CSS/HTML visual assets changed; existing UI audit baseline retained

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL lock-contention execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
